# 🍏 Leads Finder - Email 📧 + Mobile Number 📞​

The Apify actor [`microworlds/leads-finder`](https://apify.com/microworlds/leads-finder) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.227**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

✅ Cheap alternative to Apollo, ZoomInfo & Lusha. ✅ Get business emails, LinkedIn profiles, company details etc.. With verified email 📧 and mobile number 📞​

## Pricing

Pay per event — Price per lead $0.003, Actor Start $0.001 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/microworlds/leads-finder) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/microworlds-leads-finder@0.0.227#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.
